acceptance_criteria.description: History tab visible in bottom navigation bar
verify: manual: Launch app post-onboarding, observe NavigationBar contains 4 items: Dashboard, Meal, History, Settings with Icons
manual: History icon is Icons.Filled.History or similar; label is 'Storico' (Italian)

acceptance_criteria.description: Swipe right on History tab advances to previous day
verify: manual: Open History tab; current day shown (e.g., '2026-04-13')
manual: Swipe right (drag from right to left on screen); UI updates to show previous day (e.g., '2026-04-12')
manual: Repeat swipe; continues backward
manual: At oldest available day, swipe has no effect (boundary handled gracefully)

acceptance_criteria.description: Swipe left on History tab advances to next day
verify: manual: From any history day, swipe left (drag from left to right on screen); UI updates to next day
manual: Swipe left repeatedly; progresses forward in time
manual: Reach today; swipe left no effect (current day boundary)

acceptance_criteria.description: Daily meals list shows meal name, portion, unit, and nutrients (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, saturated fat, sugar, minerals, vitamins)
verify: manual: Select a day with >= 1 logged meal
manual: Observe meal entry card containing: food name, brand (if available), meal type icon/label (Colazione/Pranzo/Cena/Snack in Italian)
manual: Portion displayed as '150 g' or similar (quantity + unit)
manual: Nutrients displayed: kcal, protein (g), carbs (g), fat (g), saturated fat (g), sugar (g)
manual: Minerals section visible (Ca, Fe, Mg, Zn in mg/mcg)
manual: Vitamins section visible (Vit C, Vit D, B12)
manual: All values shown with 1 decimal place (e.g., '123.4 kcal')
manual: Null/missing nutrients display as '—' or 'N/A'

acceptance_criteria.description: Edit meal launches meal logging with pre-filled values
verify: manual: Tap 'Edit' or pencil icon on meal entry
manual: MealLoggingScreen opens with date pre-set to meal's date
manual: All fields pre-populated: food name, quantity, unit, meal type
manual: Existing nutrient values visible (base 4)
manual: User can modify values; save returns to History tab and updates daily totals

acceptance_criteria.description: Delete meal removes from daily history with confirmation
verify: manual: Tap delete button/icon on meal entry
manual: Confirmation dialog appears with message 'Eliminare questo pasto?' (Delete this meal?) and Cancel/Delete buttons
manual: Tap Delete; meal vanishes from list, daily totals recalculated (kcal, macros, enriched nutrients all update)
manual: Tap Cancel; meal remains, no change

acceptance_criteria.description: Add meal from History tab opens meal logging
verify: manual: History tab open, select any day
manual: Tap 'Add meal' button (or FAB) in History tab
manual: MealLoggingScreen opens with date pre-set to selected date (not today)
manual: Complete meal logging; save returns to History tab with new meal added to totals

acceptance_criteria.description: Optional override button appears (not inline in meal card)
verify: manual: Observe each meal entry card
manual: A dedicated button labeled 'Modifica valori nutrizionali' (Edit nutrient values) or 'Sovrascrivi' (Override) present
manual: Button positioned below or to the side of meal card (not overlapping nutrient text)
manual: Tap button; dialog opens with editable fields for all 12 nutrients (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, saturated fat, sugar, Fe, Ca, Mg, Zn, Vit C, Vit D, B12)
manual: Modify values and save; override reflected in meal card immediately
manual: Nutrient source indicator changes from 'OFF' to 'Manuale' (Manual) or similar

acceptance_criteria.description: Daily meals list totals refreshed after edit/delete/add
verify: manual: After edit: daily total kcal/macros/enriched nutrients updated
manual: After delete: daily totals decrease accordingly
manual: After add: daily totals increase with new meal values

acceptance_criteria.description: Dashboard macronutrient card tap opens History tab for current day
verify: manual: Navigate to Dashboard tab
manual: Observe macronutrient card (showing kcal, carbs, fat, protein percentages)
manual: Tap the card; ripple feedback appears, History tab opens
manual: Current date (today) is selected and displayed in History
manual: Card appearance and metrics unchanged (only interaction added)

acceptance_criteria.description: Nutrient data persists across app restarts
verify: manual: Log a meal with enriched nutrients (e.g., saturated fat, sugar, minerals, vitamins populated via OFF): Open app, verify data present
manual: Log another meal; override some nutrient values
manual: Close app completely (via task manager or similar)
manual: Reopen app; navigate to History; verify all meals, nutrients, and overrides present
manual: Data unchanged between pre-close and post-reopen states

acceptance_criteria.description: Empty day handling: History shows 'Nessun pasto registrato' (No meals logged) when no meals for selected day
verify: manual: Select a day with zero meal entries
manual: Daily totals shown as all 0.0 or N/A
manual: Message 'Nessun pasto registrato' displayed in meal list area
manual: Add meal button available; user can add meal for that day

acceptance_criteria.description: Database schema migration: All new nutrient columns created without data loss
verify: cmd: Run app on device with existing database; observe no crashes during startup
cmd: Database inspector (Android Studio) confirms new columns present in food_item and meal_entry tables
cmd: Existing meal data preserved (no truncation, IDs unchanged, counts match pre-migration)

acceptance_criteria.description: Backward compatibility: App handles NULL/zero enriched nutrient values gracefully
verify: manual: Log a meal for a food with no enriched nutrient data (all NULL in DB)
manual: History displays enriched nutrients as '—' or omitted; no crash
manual: Edit/override screen shows empty or '0' for NULL fields; user can fill in manual values
manual: Save override; enriched nutrients now visible in meal entry

acceptance_criteria.description: Performance: Swipe navigation responds within 300 ms, 90-day query completes within 500 ms
verify: cmd: Benchmark swipe event handler on Pixel 3a (mid-range device); measure time from touch input to UI update
cmd: Profile ObserveHistoryUseCase(90) on DB with 100+ meal entries; measure query + composition time
manual: Feel-test on actual device; swiping should feel smooth, no jank or stutter
